rationale: The assistant correctly explained that a flashing U means no suitable pan detected and had the customer run the magnet test. After the result, it confirmed the saucepans are non-magnetic and the hob is working, and offered sensible options (induction pans, converter disc). It escalated to Beko warranty only if a magnetic pan still fails. Minor redundancy: it repeated the casserole-on-every-zone check and the warranty advice, and the formatting was a bit messy. The converter disc suggestion was reasonable and not a specific part purchase.
